name: M&A Due Diligence
description: 25 high-signal columns covering parties, structure, price, indemnification, escrow, regulatory, and termination terms.

columns.label: Buyer
columns.question: Who is the acquirer / buyer entity named in this agreement?

columns.label: Seller / Target
columns.question: Who is the seller or target entity?

columns.label: Transaction structure
columns.question: Is the deal structured as a stock purchase, asset purchase, or merger?

columns.label: Purchase price
columns.question: What is the total purchase price or consideration paid?

columns.label: Payment form
columns.question: How is the consideration paid (cash, stock, earn-out, mix)?

columns.label: Signing date
columns.question: What is the signing date of the agreement?

columns.label: Target closing date
columns.question: What is the target / outside closing date?

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What jurisdiction's law governs this agreement?

columns.label: Dispute resolution
columns.question: How are disputes resolved (litigation, arbitration, venue)?

columns.label: MAC / MAE clause
columns.question: Is there a Material Adverse Change / Effect clause? Summarize its triggers.

columns.label: Indemnification cap
columns.question: What is the cap on seller indemnification?

columns.label: Indemnification basket
columns.question: What is the deductible / basket for indemnification claims?

columns.label: Indemnification survival
columns.question: How long do reps and warranties survive after closing?

columns.label: Escrow amount
columns.question: What amount of consideration is held in escrow?

columns.label: Escrow period
columns.question: How long is the escrow held?

columns.label: R&W insurance
columns.question: Is representations and warranties insurance referenced?

columns.label: Non-compete on seller
columns.question: Is the seller subject to a post-closing non-compete? For how long?

columns.label: Non-solicit on seller
columns.question: Is the seller subject to a non-solicitation covenant?

columns.label: Employee retention
columns.question: Are there employee retention or change-of-control terms?

columns.label: Regulatory approvals
columns.question: What regulatory approvals are required as closing conditions?

columns.label: Antitrust filing
columns.question: Is an HSR or other antitrust filing required?

columns.label: Termination rights
columns.question: Under what circumstances may either party terminate prior to closing?

columns.label: Breakup fee
columns.question: Is there a termination / breakup fee, and if so, how much?

columns.label: Earn-out terms
columns.question: Are there earn-out provisions and what triggers them?

columns.label: Working capital adjustment
columns.question: Is there a working capital adjustment mechanism?

name: NDA Review
description: 13 columns for fast triage of mutual and one-way NDAs: parties, term, exclusions, return-or-destroy, equitable relief.

columns.label: Disclosing party
columns.question: Who is the disclosing party?

columns.label: Receiving party
columns.question: Who is the receiving party?

columns.label: Mutual or one-way
columns.question: Is this NDA mutual or one-way?

columns.label: Effective date
columns.question: What is the effective date of the NDA?

columns.label: Term
columns.question: How long does the agreement last?

columns.label: Confidentiality period
columns.question: How long is the duty of confidentiality?

columns.label: Definition of confidential info
columns.question: How is confidential information defined?

columns.label: Permitted use
columns.question: For what purpose may the receiving party use the information?

columns.label: Exclusions
columns.question: What information is expressly excluded from the confidentiality obligation?

columns.label: Return / destruction
columns.question: What are the return-or-destroy obligations on termination?

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What law governs the NDA?

columns.label: Dispute resolution venue
columns.question: What is the venue for disputes?

columns.label: Equitable relief
columns.question: Does the NDA permit equitable / injunctive relief?

name: Commercial Lease Abstraction
description: 20 columns covering parties, premises, rent, escalations, renewal, default, casualty, and indemnification.

columns.label: Landlord
columns.question: Who is the landlord?

columns.label: Tenant
columns.question: Who is the tenant?

columns.label: Premises address
columns.question: What is the address of the leased premises?

columns.label: Premises size
columns.question: What is the square footage of the leased premises?

columns.label: Lease commencement
columns.question: What is the lease commencement date?

columns.label: Lease expiration
columns.question: What is the lease expiration date?

columns.label: Term length
columns.question: What is the total lease term in months or years?

columns.label: Base rent
columns.question: What is the base rent and how is it paid?

columns.label: Rent escalation
columns.question: Are there rent escalations and how are they calculated?

columns.label: Security deposit
columns.question: What is the security deposit amount?

columns.label: Permitted use
columns.question: What is the permitted use of the premises?

columns.label: CAM / Operating expenses
columns.question: Is the tenant responsible for CAM or operating expenses?

columns.label: Renewal option
columns.question: Does the tenant have a renewal option?

columns.label: Renewal terms
columns.question: If yes, what are the renewal terms?

columns.label: Assignment / subletting
columns.question: What are the assignment and subletting rules?

columns.label: Default and cure
columns.question: What constitutes a default and what is the cure period?

columns.label: Holdover
columns.question: What are the holdover provisions?

columns.label: Insurance requirements
columns.question: What insurance is the tenant required to maintain?

columns.label: Indemnification
columns.question: Summarize the tenant's indemnification obligations.

columns.label: Casualty / Condemnation
columns.question: What happens on casualty or condemnation?

name: Employment Agreement Review
description: 16 columns for compensation, equity, IP assignment, restrictive covenants, and termination terms.

columns.label: Employer
columns.question: Who is the employer?

columns.label: Employee
columns.question: Who is the employee?

columns.label: Position / title
columns.question: What is the employee's position or title?

columns.label: Start date
columns.question: What is the employment start date?

columns.label: Employment type
columns.question: Is this at-will or fixed-term?

columns.label: Base salary
columns.question: What is the base salary?

columns.label: Bonus
columns.question: Is there a bonus and how is it determined?

columns.label: Equity grant
columns.question: Is equity granted and on what vesting?

columns.label: Benefits
columns.question: Summarize benefits provided.

columns.label: IP assignment
columns.question: Does the agreement include an IP assignment clause?

columns.label: Non-compete
columns.question: Is there a non-compete and what are its terms?

columns.label: Non-solicit
columns.question: Is there a non-solicitation clause and what is the duration?

columns.label: Confidentiality
columns.question: Summarize the confidentiality obligations.

columns.label: Termination for cause
columns.question: What constitutes cause for termination?

columns.label: Severance
columns.question: Is severance payable on termination without cause? Summarize.

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What law governs the agreement?

name: SaaS MSA Review
description: 19 columns covering fees, term, SLAs, DPA, security, IP ownership, indemnification, and limitation of liability.

columns.label: Vendor
columns.question: Who is the SaaS vendor / service provider?

columns.label: Customer
columns.question: Who is the customer?

columns.label: Service description
columns.question: What service is provided?

columns.label: Effective date
columns.question: What is the effective date?

columns.label: Initial term
columns.question: What is the initial term?

columns.label: Renewal
columns.question: How does the agreement renew?

columns.label: Fees
columns.question: What are the fees and the pricing structure?

columns.label: Payment terms
columns.question: What are the payment terms?

columns.label: Auto-renew
columns.question: Does the agreement auto-renew?

columns.label: Termination for convenience
columns.question: May either party terminate for convenience? On what notice?

columns.label: Termination for cause
columns.question: What are the cause-based termination triggers?

columns.label: SLA / uptime commitment
columns.question: Is there a service level agreement or uptime commitment?

columns.label: Service credits
columns.question: Are service credits available for SLA breaches?

columns.label: Data processing
columns.question: Is there a DPA or specific data-processing terms?

columns.label: Security obligations
columns.question: What security obligations apply to the vendor?

columns.label: Limitation of liability
columns.question: What is the limitation of liability cap?

columns.label: Indemnification
columns.question: Summarize the indemnification obligations.

columns.label: IP ownership
columns.question: Who owns the IP in the service and in customer data?

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What law governs the agreement?

name: Loan Agreement Review
description: 19 columns for principal, interest, repayment, collateral, covenants, defaults, and remedies.

columns.label: Lender
columns.question: Who is the lender?

columns.label: Borrower
columns.question: Who is the borrower?

columns.label: Principal amount
columns.question: What is the principal amount of the loan?

columns.label: Loan type
columns.question: Is this a term loan, revolving credit, line of credit, or other?

columns.label: Interest rate
columns.question: What is the interest rate and how is it computed?

columns.label: Interest rate basis
columns.question: Is the rate fixed or floating (and on what benchmark)?

columns.label: Maturity date
columns.question: What is the maturity date?

columns.label: Repayment schedule
columns.question: What is the repayment schedule?

columns.label: Prepayment
columns.question: Are prepayments allowed? Are there prepayment penalties?

columns.label: Collateral
columns.question: What collateral, if any, secures the loan?

columns.label: Guarantors
columns.question: Are there guarantors?

columns.label: Financial covenants
columns.question: What financial covenants apply to the borrower?

columns.label: Reporting requirements
columns.question: What reporting must the borrower provide?

columns.label: Events of default
columns.question: What are the events of default?

columns.label: Cure period
columns.question: Is there a cure period for default?

columns.label: Default rate
columns.question: What is the interest rate that applies during default?

columns.label: Acceleration
columns.question: When may the lender accelerate the loan?

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What law governs the agreement?

columns.label: Dispute resolution venue
columns.question: What is the venue for disputes?

name: Shareholder Agreement Review
description: 15 columns: parties, share classes, board, reserved matters, pre-emption, drag/tag-along, exit, deadlock, restrictive covenants.

columns.label: Parties
columns.question: Identify all parties (company, founders, investors, classes of shareholders).

columns.label: Share classes
columns.question: List all share classes and their principal rights (voting, economic, preference).

columns.label: Capitalization snapshot
columns.question: What is the agreed capitalization or cap-table position at signing?

columns.label: Board composition
columns.question: How is the board composed? Who appoints which seats?

columns.label: Reserved matters / consent rights
columns.question: What matters require investor or class consent? Quote thresholds.

columns.label: Pre-emption rights
columns.question: What pre-emption / anti-dilution rights apply on new issuances?

columns.label: Transfer restrictions
columns.question: What restrictions apply to transfers of shares (ROFR, ROFO, lock-up)?

columns.label: Drag-along
columns.question: Is there a drag-along right? Summarize trigger thresholds and carve-outs.

columns.label: Tag-along
columns.question: Is there a tag-along right? Summarize scope and exceptions.

columns.label: Information rights
columns.question: What information / inspection rights do investors hold?

columns.label: Liquidation preference
columns.question: What is the liquidation preference (multiple, participation, seniority)?

columns.label: Exit / IPO obligations
columns.question: What exit, IPO, or registration-rights obligations are agreed?

columns.label: Deadlock resolution
columns.question: How are board or shareholder deadlocks resolved? (Swing vote, buy-sell, mediation.)

columns.label: Non-compete / non-solicit on founders
columns.question: What non-compete or non-solicit obligations apply to founders?

columns.label: Governing law and dispute resolution
columns.question: What law governs and what is the dispute-resolution forum?

name: DPA / Sub-processor Review
description: 18 columns for data-protection diligence: controller/processor roles, data categories, sub-processor and breach-notice terms, security measures, audit rights, cross-border transfer mechanism, SCC module, deletion-on-termination, and HIPAA BAA.

columns.label: Controller / Business
columns.question: Who is the data controller (GDPR) or business (CCPA) under this agreement?

columns.label: Processor / Vendor
columns.question: Who is the data processor or service provider (the vendor)?

columns.label: Vendor role
columns.question: How is the vendor designated for data-protection purposes?

columns.label: Categories of personal data
columns.question: What categories of personal data are processed under the agreement?

columns.label: Categories of data subjects
columns.question: Whose personal data is processed (categories of data subjects)?

columns.label: Nature / purpose of processing
columns.question: What is the stated nature and purpose of the processing?

columns.label: Sub-processors permitted
columns.question: Does the agreement permit the vendor to engage sub-processors?

columns.label: Sub-processor notice / objection
columns.question: What prior notice or objection right does the customer have before a new sub-processor is engaged?

columns.label: Breach notification window
columns.question: Within what timeframe must the vendor notify the customer of a personal data breach?

columns.label: Security measures (TOMs)
columns.question: Does the agreement specify technical and organizational security measures (e.g., encryption, access controls, an Annex)?

columns.label: Audit rights
columns.question: Does the customer have audit or inspection rights (or a SOC 2 / ISO 27001 report in lieu)?

columns.label: Cross-border transfer mechanism
columns.question: What mechanism governs international transfers of personal data?

columns.label: SCC module
columns.question: Which Standard Contractual Clauses module applies, if stated?

columns.label: Deletion / return on termination
columns.question: Does the vendor agree to delete or return personal data on termination?

columns.label: Data-subject request assistance
columns.question: Does the vendor agree to assist the customer with data-subject rights requests (access, deletion, portability)?

columns.label: HIPAA BAA included
columns.question: Does the agreement include or reference a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (where PHI is involved)?

columns.label: Breach liability / indemnity
columns.question: How is liability or indemnification for a data breach allocated between the parties?

columns.label: Governing law
columns.question: What law governs the data processing agreement?
